proposed_comments.title: Preserve the useful file-type preview when exact refinement falls back
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the useful file-type preview when exact refinement falls back

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/CachedIconSourceProvider.cs` (exact refinement result selection).

**Suggested change:** Treat `ShellItemIconFallback` as a fallback result rather than replacing a successful intermediate file-type icon with it. Keep the intermediate source when exact refinement produces only the generic fallback, and add a regression test for that completion path.

confidence.rationale: The current null-coalescing selection accepts the non-null generic fallback before the more useful intermediate result.

proposed_comments.title: Recheck Shell image-list generation before sharing or extracting cached locations
proposed_comments.body:
### Recheck Shell image-list generation before sharing or extracting cached locations

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/IconLoaderService.cs` (canonical-load arbitration and extraction).

**Suggested change:** For `SystemImageList` identities, verify `ShellIconLocations.IsCurrent` immediately before joining an existing materialized load and again after extraction. If the generation changed, discard the location, retry boundedly, and fall back to a path-specific identity instead of publishing an icon extracted from a stale system-image-list index.

confidence.rationale: The supplied or cached location can become stale between lookup, task sharing, and extraction while the design depends on generation-safe invalidation.

proposed_comments.title: Invalidate cached Shell identities on image-list update notifications
proposed_comments.body:
### Invalidate cached Shell identities on image-list update notifications

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/ShellIconCacheInvalidator.cs` (notification registration and message handling).

**Suggested change:** Register for `SHCNE_UPDATEIMAGE`, read the delivered event ID from `SHChangeNotification_Lock`, and invalidate with a dedicated update-image reason. Windows can replace an existing system image-list entry without an association change, while the current code subscribes only to `SHCNE_ASSOCCHANGED` and does not classify the delivered event.

confidence.rationale: System image-list replacement uses SHCNE_UPDATEIMAGE, which is absent from the registration and event classification.

proposed_comments.title: Avoid poisoning shared file-type aliases with path-specific fallback results
proposed_comments.body:
### Avoid poisoning shared file-type aliases with path-specific fallback results

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/ShellIconLocationResolver.cs` (`FileType` fallback and alias caching).

**Suggested change:** Make path-specific fallback locations from a failed file-type lookup non-cacheable as extension-wide aliases. The fallback extraction should return an empty result rather than the original item's thumbnail stream, so exact refinement remains the first item-specific load and one transient `.txt` lookup cannot poison every `.txt` request.

confidence.rationale: The resolver can store an ItemPath fallback beneath the request's shared FileType cache identity.

proposed_comments.title: Make direct-image thumbnail identities change when the file changes
proposed_comments.body:
### Make direct-image thumbnail identities change when the file changes

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/ShellItemIconLocator.cs` (direct-image thumbnail identity).

**Suggested change:** Include a cheap file version such as `File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(itemPath).Ticks` in the thumbnail identity and avoid caching the direct-image raw alias. Normal file-content edits do not necessarily raise association or system-image-list invalidations, so a path-only identity can keep returning an old preview.

confidence.rationale: The current identity contains only path and size mode, neither of which changes when the image contents are replaced.

proposed_comments.title: Use the real binary-icon parser before excluding legacy Shell paths
proposed_comments.body:
### Use the real binary-icon parser before excluding legacy Shell paths

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/ShellItemIconRequestClassifier.cs` (`LooksLikeBinaryIconReference`).

**Suggested change:** Reuse `IconPathParser.TryParseBinaryIconReference` so only genuine `file,index` references bypass Shell item loading. The current first-comma split rejects valid paths such as `C:\folder.exe,assets\report.txt` without checking whether the suffix is an icon index. Add classifier coverage for comma-containing filesystem paths.

confidence.rationale: The heuristic validates the binary-looking prefix but not the comma suffix, unlike the existing parser.

proposed_comments.title: Disable Shell alias caching when change notifications are unavailable
proposed_comments.body:
### Disable Shell alias caching when change notifications are unavailable

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/ShellIconCacheInvalidator.cs` (notification-registration failure path).

**Suggested change:** Disable and clear the shared Shell location alias cache when desktop resolution or notification registration fails, and re-enable it only after registration succeeds. Frequency-based cache decay is not a correctness invalidation mechanism for aliases that map paths to system image-list identities.

confidence.rationale: The alias cache has no correctness TTL, so the logged promise of normal expiry cannot prevent stale Shell identity reuse.
